name: Anivia
title: the Cryophoenix

Q.name: Flash Frost
Q.description: Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing 50/70/90/110/130 + 0.25×AP magic damage and Chilling enemies for 3 seconds, Slowing them by @Spell.GlacialStorm:SlowAmount@%. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds and dealing 60/95/130/165/200 + 0.45×AP magic damage. Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.
Q.summary: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

W.name: Crystallize
W.description: Anivia summons a wall of ice 400/500/600/700/800 units wide. The wall lasts for 5 seconds before it melts.
W.summary: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

E.name: Frostbite
E.description: Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing 55/80/105/130/155 + 0.55×AP magic damage. Against Chilled enemies, Anivia deals (55/80/105/130/155 + 0.55×AP) × 2 magic damage instead.
E.summary: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.

R.name: Glacial Storm
R.description: Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by 20/30/40% and deals 30/45/60 + 0.125×AP magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over 1.5 seconds. When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by 30/45/60%, and does (30/45/60 + 0.125×AP) × 3 magic damage per second instead.
R.summary: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

Passive.name: Rebirth
Passive.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.
Passive.summary: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Zone-control mage: stuns with Q, blocks paths with W wall, and melts waves and fights with her R storm; egg passive cheats one death.
strengths: Very strong wave clear with R once she has mana
Q stun + E double damage on chilled targets
W wall splits fights and blocks escapes or ganks
Passive egg protects from early all-ins
weaknesses: Immobile and slow early; weak before 6
Q is a slow, dodgeable missile
Egg can be broken by burst

curve.lvl6: strong – R wave clear and zone

profile.curveNote: Survives lanes to level 6; then plays around R.

keyAbilities.engage: Q, W wall to cut escape

Passive.notes: reborn as an egg once (long cooldown)

W.notes: terrain wall: blocks movement, can trap or cut off

E.notes: point-and-click; double damage on chilled targets

R.notes: toggle storm; chills when fully formed

profile.windowAgainst: Q on cooldown (no stun) or egg passive used.
